### Full Job Description
Summary:
Senior Software Engineer developing backend services and distributed systems for Alteryx. Building a cloud platform using Go, React, and TypeScript in a high-performing team.
Senior Software Engineer developing cloud applications for Alteryx
Role description:
• Join our high-performing Data Plane Platform team, building the foundation of Alteryx's next-generation cloud platform.
• Work with challenges at the heart of modern business.
• Build scalable services, APIs, and distributed systems using Go.
• Contribute across the stack using React and TypeScript for customer-facing platform management experiences.
Role requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
• 5+ years of professional software development experience.
• Strong experience building backend services using Go, REST APIs, and distributed systems.
• Experience developing and operating production cloud applications on AWS or GCP.
• Experience with JavaScript/TypeScript and React or a similar frontend framework.
• Familiarity with microservices, event-driven architectures, and cloud-native application design.
• Experience with testing, CI/CD pipelines, Git, and modern software development practices.
• Ability to troubleshoot issues across application code, cloud infrastructure, and production environments.
• Strong communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills with an ownership mindset.
